metadata.title: Hodge Conjecture Lean 4 Formalization Suite (Papers 1-6, 42 Modules, 208 Zero-Axiom Declarations), Bridge Lemmas H1-H2 & Stage 1-3 Certificates
metadata.description:
Verified release archive accompanying the six-paper Lean 4.35.0 series (13 baseline modules + 28 extension modules, 208 axiom-free kernel declarations, 26/26 symbolic/GPU explorers, six peer-review-formatted manuscripts with 13 TikZ diagrams, and a plain-English guide HODGE_FOR_EVERYONE_PLAIN_ENGLISH_ARTICLE.md) covering Shioda-Aoki cyclotomic character combinatorics through m=60, m=25,35,49,55 conical Schur ladders, Wiebe-Scheja-Storch transition determinants (G<=3 over Z), Spin(8) triality, Cl(0,7) chiral Schur complement (1152), Spin(7) Cayley calibration, CM graph realization (2 Z_CM = T_ch), order-8 Gauss-Manin jet transport, CY4 Koszul Hilbert profile, finite Gysin exactness, Cayley-trick complete-intersection profiles in P^6, Poly6 evaluation homomorphisms, and conditional Fermat algebraicity bridges.

Scope and Scientific Honesty: Every unconditional Lean 4 theorem in this deposit proves exact finite-dimensional combinatorial, polynomial-quotient, matrix-operator, or Lie-algebraic results, while classical Lefschetz, Griffiths, Shioda, and Aoki algebraic-geometry bridges are isolated inside explicit modular hypothesis structures (FermatFourfoldHodgeBridge). The Clay Millennium Hodge Conjecture (HODGE-MILLENNIUM-001) and global Wall1-Wall5 cycle realization on generic smooth projective varieties remain strictly OPEN.
metadata.notes: All 6 manuscripts passed pdflatex (0 errors, 0 overfull, 0 underfull, >= 2 TikZ figures each) and live SHA-256 verification against FULL_AUTOMATION_VERIFICATION_RECEIPT.json and MILLENNIUM_EXT_RECEIPT.json.
